title: #10 Nettan Lindgren, BMW Dealer Team Sweden BMW M3, BTCC 1991
note: Layout from the TV graphics drawings A_grid_r01_silverstone_b_sharp_15 and A_grid_r03_donington_sharp_13 (white car, stripe band along the top of the front wing and along the rear quarter from the C-pillar to the tail, number board at the front of the front door). Colours from the right-side frames B_right_tv Season Review 00-12-30 and C_right_tv Round 2 Pt 1 00-05-45 (no left-side picture of #10): BMW M stripes, red at the nose and up the C-pillar, violet, light blue at the A-pillar and the tail; red ESSO sticker above a white number board; Castrol on the rear quarter; 'Lindgren' in white on the rear side window. The TV drawing shows the stripe colours as teal and blue, the photos as M colours. Wheels: gold mesh (BBS style) with a polished lip from the Season Review 00-12-30 frame, where the car stands in the gravel after its crash; no paddock photo found. Sizes checked against the photos relative to the door height and wheel size (the --compare overlay of the TV drawing was misaligned): stripe band about a fifth of the door height thick (photos; the TV drawing shows it thicker), number board about 13% of the wheelbase wide.
